test_title: PYST 54: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 21 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: India's SDG ranking in the 10th Sustainable Development Report was released by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**UN Sustainable Development Solutions Network**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Sustainable Development Report (SDR)**, which includes the **SDG Index** and **Dashboards**, is a global assessment of countries' progress towards achieving the **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**.
 
• This report is released annually by the **UN Sustainable Development Solutions Network (SDSN)**. ***Hence, the correct answer is option 2.***
 
• The **SDSN** has been publishing these reports since **2016** (with earlier iterations dating back to the adoption of the goals), and the **2024** edition marks the **9th** global edition, while the **10th** anniversary of the **SDSN** itself or specific regional versions often lead to the "10th" nomenclature in various academic contexts.
 
• The report provides a **score (0–100)** for each country, representing the percentage of **SDG** achievement. A score of **100** indicates that all targets have been met.
 
• It uses a **"traffic light"** system (green, yellow, orange, red) in its **Dashboards** to help countries identify where they are lagging and where they are making progress across the **17 Goals**.
 
• The **Sustainable Development Solutions Network** operates under the auspices of the **UN Secretary-General** and was established in **2012**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **World Economic Forum (WEF):**
 
 
• The **WEF** is an international non-governmental organization based in **Cologny, Switzerland**, founded by **Klaus Schwab** in **1971**.
 
• It is famous for its annual meeting in **Davos** and releases reports such as the **Global Gender Gap Report**, **Global Competitiveness Report**, and **Global Risks Report**.
 
• It does not release the primary global **SDG Index**.
 
 
 
• **World Bank Report:**
 
 
• The **World Bank** is an international financial institution that provides loans and grants to the governments of low- and middle-income countries.
 
• Its flagship publication is the **World Development Report (WDR)**, which focuses on a different aspect of development each year (e.g., **Digital Dividends**, **Governance and the Law**).
 
• While it provides data for the **SDGs**, it is not the publisher of the **Sustainable Development Report**.
 
 
 
• **International Monetary Fund (IMF) Report:**
 
 
• The **IMF** focuses on global monetary cooperation, financial stability, and international trade.
 
• Major reports include the **World Economic Outlook (WEO)**, **Global Financial Stability Report**, and **Fiscal Monitor**.
 
• The **IMF** monitors macroeconomic health rather than specific **SDG** indicator rankings.
 
 
 
• **The 17 SDGs:**
 
 
• Adopted by all **193 United Nations Member States** in **September 2015** as part of the **2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development**.
 
• Key goals include **Goal 1: No Poverty**, **Goal 5: Gender Equality**, **Goal 13: Climate Action**, and **Goal 17: Partnerships for the Goals**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **SDSN Leadership:** The **SDSN** is currently led by **Professor Jeffrey Sachs**, a world-renowned economist and expert in sustainable development.
 
• **Data Sources:** The report relies heavily on official data from the **United Nations**, **World Bank**, **World Health Organization (WHO)**, and **International Labour Organization (ILO)**, as well as non-official data where gaps exist.
 
• **India's Context:** In the **Sustainable Development Report 2024**, **India** was ranked **109th** out of **166** countries with a score of approximately **64.0**. The country has shown progress in goals like **Climate Action** and **Responsible Consumption** but faces challenges in **Zero Hunger (Goal 2)** and **Gender Equality (Goal 5)**.
 
• **Spillover Index:** A unique feature of the **SDSN** report is the **Spillover Index**, which measures the positive and negative effects one country has on another's ability to achieve the **SDGs** (e.g., through trade, security, or environmental impacts).
